title: OxyGeneo facial in Cairo
description: Find out about OxyGeneo facials in Cairo for surface dullness and rough texture, from checking ingredient sensitivity to exfoliation and aftercare.
answer: An OxyGeneo facial combines surface exfoliation with the application of skincare ingredients. Adults with dullness or rough surface texture can ask about this option at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin.
